==== tluaBuiltinNamespaceColonForm.tlua (4 errors) ====
    // A colon call fills the function's first parameter with its receiver. That is
    // true of the namespace globals too -- `string:match(a, b)` is
    // `string.match(string, a, b)` -- so the refiners' positional reads shift there
    // exactly as they do for a member call. The receiver is the wrong type in these,
    // which the declared signature reports; what is pinned here is that the refiner
    // reads the argument Lua would read, or declines to refine.
    
    // Two literals with different capture counts, so which one is taken as the
    // pattern shows up in the pack's arity. The pattern is the first WRITTEN
    // argument here, giving two captures -- a third value is nil.
    local x1, x2, x3 = string:match("(a)(b)", "(a)(b)(c)");
                       ~~~~~~
!!! error TLUA2345: Argument of type 'StringLib' is not assignable to parameter of type 'string'.
    
    // The namespace dot form does write its subject first, so the pattern is second
    // and all three captures land.
    local y1, y2, y3 = string.match("subject", "(a)(b)(c)");
    
    // The member forms are unchanged by any of this.
    local text: string = "ab";
    local m1, m2, m3 = text:match("(a)(b)");
    local n1, n2, n3 = text.match(text, "(a)(b)");
